reports.title: Regency Centers Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Regency Centers is providing updated 2026 Guidance, as summarized in the table below. Please refer to the Company’s third quarter 2026 "Earnings Presentation" and "Quarterly Supplemental Disclosure" for additional detail. All materials are posted on the Company’s website at investors.regencycenters.com.

Full Year 2026 Guidance (in thousands, except per share data) | YTD Actual | Current2026 Guidance | Prior2026 Guidance
Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders per diluted share | $1.70 | $2.31 - $2.33 | $2.48 - $2.52
Nareit Funds From Operations (“Nareit FFO”) per diluted share | $3.64 | $4.86 - $4.88 | $4.84 - $4.88
Core Operating Earnings per diluted share(1) | $3.50 | $4.65 - $4.67 | $4.62 - $4.66

Core Operating Earnings excludes from Nareit FFO: (i) transaction related income or expenses; (ii) gains or losses from the early extinguishment of debt; (iii) certain non-cash components of earnings derived from straight-line rents, above and below market rent amortization, and debt and derivative mark-to-market amortization; and (iv) other amounts as they occur.
Includes above and below market rent amortization and straight-line rents, and excludes debt and derivative mark to market amortization.

desk.headline: Nareit FFO up 7% to $1.23 a share, just above estimates; full-year FFO guidance raised and dividend lifted 6%
results: Nareit FFO rose to $230.8m, or $1.23 a share, from $1.15; Core Operating Earnings rose to $1.18 from $1.09.
GAAP net income fell to $0.41 a share from $0.58 after a $65.1m ($0.35 a share) impairment charge, partly offset by $23.8m of property sale gains.
Same property NOI grew 5.1%; the portfolio was 97.0% leased and 95.1% commenced, both higher than a year ago.
New and renewal leases on 1.7m sq ft were signed at rents 11.9% above the old leases on a cash basis.
Started $101m of developments in the quarter ($241m year to date); net debt and preferred stock at 4.9x EBITDAre; quarterly dividend raised 6% to $0.80.

guidance.summary: Regency raised its 2026 Nareit FFO and Core Operating Earnings ranges and lifted same property NOI growth to 4.25% or more. GAAP EPS guidance was cut because of the impairment charge.

points: Leasing demand was described as broad-based, with renewal cash spreads improving to about 15% and tenant retention at a high of about 84%.
Nearly all new small-shop leases include yearly rent increases of 3% or more.
For 2027, management pointed to same property NOI growth in the mid-3% range, slower than 2026, with higher bad debt and refinancing costs as headwinds.
Development starts for 2026 are tracking toward about $400m; new projects are expected to earn lower yields (about 7–8%) than the current pipeline.
Risks flagged included volatile interest rates for acquisitions and Albertsons reviewing its real estate.
call.source: Call coverage: Earnings Whispers (via Finviz), 6 Nov 2026 — summary article, speakers not named

watch: Formal 2027 guidance and whether same property NOI growth slows to the mid-3% range.
Further impairments or property sales after the $65.1m charge.
Rent spreads and occupancy holding near record levels.
